comfortPhases.title: Sensory & Comfort Assessment
comfortPhases.subtitle: Personal Comfort Review
comfortPhases.description: We listen carefully to your previous dental experiences, concerns, and medical history. Your operatory is tailored with calming ambient lighting and soothing comfort.
comfortPhases.sensoryNote: A relaxed, unrushed conversation sitting upright in comfort.

comfortPhases.title: Topical Pre-Numb & Local Anesthesia
comfortPhases.subtitle: Zero-Pinch Anesthetic Protocol
comfortPhases.description: A pleasant topical gel pre-numbs the area completely before gentle micro-anesthetic is introduced. You remain comfortably relaxed throughout.
comfortPhases.sensoryNote: Mild numbness and soothing calmness without clinical stress.
comfortPhases.keySafeguard: Buffered anesthetic to minimize stinging or sharp sensations.

comfortPhases.title: Gentle Micro-Care & Surgical Precision
comfortPhases.subtitle: Atraumatic Tooth Preservation
comfortPhases.description: Dr. Poornima performs the extraction or restorative procedure using precision instruments. Bone and soft tissue are treated gently to promote swift recovery.
comfortPhases.sensoryNote: Zero sharp sensations. Soft background hum with continuous check-ins.
comfortPhases.keySafeguard: Careful monitoring and gentle tissue handling.

comfortPhases.title: Post-Care & Swift Recovery
comfortPhases.subtitle: Same-Day Return to Ease
comfortPhases.description: Following procedure completion, clear printed post-care instructions and direct clinic WhatsApp follow-up support are provided.
comfortPhases.sensoryNote: Clear-headed, relaxed, with immediate tension relief.
comfortPhases.keySafeguard: Direct follow-up line with Dr. Poornima for total peace of mind.
